title: Oracle Partners With OpenAI to Bring ChatGPT and Codex to Enterprise Workflows
hook_text: Oracle just teamed up with OpenAI.
script:
Oracle just partnered with OpenAI to bring ChatGPT and Codex to enterprise workflows.
Businesses can now run ChatGPT inside Oracle Cloud Infrastructure for heavy operational workloads.
OpenAI Codex will help corporate software developers write and debug code at scale.
The collaboration links OpenAI models directly with Oracle database infrastructure.
Analytics India Magazine detailed how this integration expands enterprise AI adoption globally.
Would your engineering team migrate core database workflows to OpenAI tools?
